title: Why you mishear song lyrics: Your brain fills in the blanks
hook: Ever misheard a song lyric and couldn't unhear it?

narration.text: Ever misheard a song lyric and couldn't unhear it?
Your brain is actually trying to make sense of the sounds.
Our brains predict what we expect to hear.
This is a process called predictive coding.
When the sound is unclear, our brain fills in the gaps.
We often interpret ambiguous sounds as something familiar, like words.
So, even if the lyrics are wrong, your brain might insist they are right.
What is the funniest lyric you have ever misheard?

description: Discover why you sometimes mishear song lyrics. It's not just you; your brain is actively trying to make sense of ambiguous sounds through auditory pareidolia and predictive coding. Learn how your mind fills in the gaps, often creating words where there are none.
topic: Why you might mishear words in a song, explaining auditory pareidolia and predictive coding.
